title: Thresholds
subtitle: The most specific set in force wins. An equipment override replaces the standard without changing it.

standards.title: Standards
standards.subtitle: The standard assigned to an equipment decides its bands. Switching it re-grades the equipment without touching a threshold.
standards.noClasses: This standard does not classify by machine type

metric.inUseHint: with at least one band set

statuses.title: Statuses
statuses.subtitle: Colour and name come from here; each technique picks which ones it offers.
statuses.availabilityHint: Declared by the technician; they explain why there is no value.

sets.title: Band sets
sets.hint: Listed from the most specific scope to the most general: the first one that matches an equipment wins.

form.standardHint: A standard judges the services it was written for. ISO 10816-3 is vibration; NETA MTS is thermography.
form.name: Name
form.sourceHint: Title or scope of the standard
form.techniquesHint: Pick none to make it a house criterion that applies to any service.
form.machineClassesHint: Optional: ISO 10816-3 uses Classes I to IV.
form.setHint: Pick the magnitude first: it fixes the service and therefore which standards may apply.
form.magnitudeHint: What is measured and in what unit
form.scopeHint: The most specific one in force wins
form.bandsHint: From (inclusive) to (exclusive). Leave empty for infinity. They cannot overlap.
form.rationaleHint: Why this criterion exists; it shows up in the report.
form.statusHint: Condition is computed from the value; availability is declared by the technician.
form.severityHint: Higher is worse; it orders the statuses
form.measurable: Can be measured in this state
form.magnitudeFormHint: A magnitude belongs to exactly one service.
form.aggregationHint: Gs peak and Gs peak-to-peak are different criteria
form.higherIsWorseHint: Viscosity and dielectric strength get worse as they drop
